description: Everything an agent needs to write and review TypeScript the way the OCX family does: the type-aware lint gate that most repositories never actually wire, sixteen merge-blocking non-negotiables, twelve depth files covering types, async, errors, the CLI exit-code and stream contract, resources, modules and resolution, security, testing, observability, browser SPAs and the editor extension host — plus the tsconfig strictness floor per project shape, version-gated compiler flags, and the manifest and publish-verification rules for a package that ships a bin.
name: typescript-essentials
summary: The OCX TypeScript quality set — standards for Node CLIs, published packages, browser SPAs and editor extension hosts, plus the tsconfig strictness floor and manifest policy
